subject: combining and analysing different samples vs control

messages.author: 0252aa2de4f3da23
messages.subject: combining and analysing different samples vs control
parts:
Hi,

I have sequenced samples from cell lines treated with different drug dosages for 24 hrs i.e. 0ug, 2ug, and 8ug each with three biological replitcates, where 0ug is our control. We have obtained RNAseq and RRBS data for these samples. In RNAseq, besides typical comparison (0ug vs 2ug and 0ug vs. 8ug), we also analysed 2ug and 8ug together against control i.e. (0ug vs. 2ug & 8ug) using DESeq2. Do you know how can I combine the samples and do the same for my RRBS data using methylkit? Many thanks.

cheers,
adnan

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] combining and analysing different samples vs control
parts:
In your last case, you can treat 2ug & 8ug as test and 0ug as control. you need to change the treatment vector when reading all the samples or if you have all the samples in a methylBase object, you can alter the treatment vector using reorganize() function.

Best,
Altuna

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] combining and analysing different samples vs control
parts:
Hi again and thanks for the reply. What I understood is that if I have written the following command for 2ugVS0ug : 

myobj=read(file.list, sample.id=list("test1","test2","test3","ctrl1","ctrl2","ctrl3"),assembly="UMD3.1", treatment=c(1,1,1,0,0,0))

should be changed to the following (if i want 2ug_8ug VS 0ug) :

myobj=read(file.list, sample.id=list("test1","test2","test3","test4","test5","test6","ctrl1","ctrl2","ctrl3"),assembly="UMD3.1", treatment=c(1,1,1,1,1,1,0,0,0))

Am I right?

cheers,
adnan
